integrations.name: Claude Code native OpenTelemetry into Phoenix
integrations.configuration: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1 and CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA=1; OTLP http/protobuf to a local tee keeping raw traces/logs/metrics, traces forwarded to local Phoenix (SQLite, no auth); content flags OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS/TOOL_DETAILS/TOOL_CONTENT/ASSISTANT_RESPONSES=1 and raw API bodies to files in runs 1-2, none in run 3; detailed beta tracing off.
integrations.input_source: Three live Claude Code runs (cc-run1 multi-tool/failure/denial/sub-agent with thinking, cc-run2 SIGINT interrupt, cc-run3 default privacy).
integrations.readback_status: Persisted local Phoenix database read back (reduced copy tracked); 50/50 readback checks as expected, several asserting expected absence.
integrations.notes: OTLP logs and metrics are rejected by Phoenix OSS (405), so log-only facts are outside this route. A separate emitter-independent probe (size-probe.txt, synthetic sentinel spans) found Phoenix stores 1 KB to 8 MB strings byte-for-byte; that is a store property, not an observation of this route.

integrations.notes: Replayed inputs persisted into Phoenix and read back from the database; classed replay-observed because the input is replayed, not a live Claude Code run.
